findings.note: The three sibling methodologies of alchemical-sciences-methodology#edition-aonid. Each ships Player Core 2 text under the APG's aonId with edition 'legacy', so hide-legacy deletes a class feature the character legitimately has. Remaster ids read off the AoN mirror: methodology-2.remaster_id = ["methodology-6"], methodology-3 -> methodology-7, methodology-4 -> methodology-8. Each edition row supersedes the existing overlay row whose value is 'legacy'.

backfillRows.why: We ship Empiricism's CURRENT text (source.book "Pathfinder Player Core 2") while pointing at the Advanced Player's Guide printing methodology-2, whose own remaster_id in the AoN mirror is ["methodology-6"], and tagging the record edition 'legacy'. applyEditionFilter (src/rules/build.ts:3131-3145) DROPS a 'legacy' record when a character has hide-legacy on, taking the record's grantsActions and the investigator methodology control with it — a mechanical loss, not a hidden description. methodology-6 is the Player Core 2 printing of the same methodology. Identical defect to alchemical-sciences-methodology#edition-aonid (methodology-1 -> methodology-5) in work/.b033-rows-data-rows.json, which is the finding this row is the sibling of.

findings.note: The 33 remaining IWR entries whose printed limit sits in an unread `note` key, across five barbarian instinct records (decay/fury/spirit `whileActive`, elemental/superstition `choice`). Each field is re-emitted whole because a field is one row, and each supersedes the overlay row that already holds it. The clause text is unchanged — only the key it lives under.

resistances.condition: attacks and abilities of creatures with the fungus trait, regardless of damage type

backfillRows.why: AoN instinct-15 prints the limits these resistances are subject to, and the shipped value carried each one in a `note` key. IwrEntry (src/rules/types.ts) declares type/value/against/minLevel/whenCreatureTrait/unlessCreatureTrait/whenVoidHealing/condition and nothing else, and the resistance loop (src/rules/derive.ts:2701-2740) renders exactly `r.condition ?? src.__cond` beside the number — so `note` is stored and read by nobody, and every one of these clauses is invisible on the sheet. Renaming the key to `condition` is the whole fix; the value is otherwise byte-identical, re-emitted whole because a field is one row. Same defect and same repair as skin-hard-as-horn in work/.b033-rows-data-rows.json (its 3 entries; these are the remaining 33 of the 36 in core.json).

findings.note: The create row the data-rows family specified and could not author until a reader existed. src/rules/featUses.ts effectiveUses() now prefers a `<featureId>-<subclassId>` variant's limitedUses over the generic record's, and featUse() keys the spend on the generic id so the Feats tab (which shows the variant, FeatsTab.tsx:189) and the Main tab (which shows the action the generic grants) share one counter instead of drawing two independent pip rows.

backfillRows.why: AoN arcane-school-21 (School of Unified Magical Theory): "instead of using Drain Bonded Item only once per day, you can use it once per day for each rank of spell you can cast, recalling a spell of that rank each time." classFeatures/arcane-bond ships {max:1, per:"day"} flat, so a UMT wizard was held to one use at every level. The `<featureId>-<subclassId>` variant is how this project already carries a subclass's version of a shared class feature (owned at src/rules/derive.ts:3428-3442, shown at src/sheet/FeatsTab.tsx:189); the maxByLevel ladder is the wizard rank-by-level table (rank 2 at 3rd … rank 10 at 19th). No description: the created record has none, and the FeatsTab row shows it — that prose is owed to a created-prose spec, see work/.b033-report-gap-data-rows.txt.

findings.note: Code-only, no core.json row exists to author: the duplicate was in src/rules/featGrantsAuto.ts. All eight animist apparition entries (crafter-in-the-vault, echo-of-lost-moments, impostor-in-hidden-places, lurker-in-devouring-dark, monarch-of-the-fey-courts, stalker-in-darkened-boughs, steward-of-stone-and-fire, vanguard-of-roaring-waters) are removed; the class option's grants.lores + loreProgression already grant the same Lores with the printed 8th/16th ladder at src/rules/build.ts:3620, and the removed entries granted them again flat at trained.

The third copy of the sentence, in src/rules/companionGrants.ts — the eidolon companion note still read "an extra 1 spirit (good) damage" with no holy trait, no target restriction and no nonlethal clause. Replaced with AoN eidolon-1's wording, the same text the data-rows description row carries.

No row could reach it: the stale copy is classes.psychic.subclass.options[the-tangible-dream].description, and core-descriptions.json is already correct. src/data/index.ts loadDescriptions() now syncs every subclass / extra-choice OPTION from the classFeatures entry of the same id — 45 stale options across 11 classes, this record among them.
